title: Cloudflare ka Clairic - AI jo sirf values nikalta hai
content:
Ek aisa AI model aaya hai jo ek bhi word GENERATE nahi karta.
And that is exactly why it is useful.
Cloudflare ne kal launch kiya hai... Clairic.
Clairic ek extraction model hai.
Aap usko messy text ya image do, jaise ek invoice ya customer email.
Aur bolo... mujhe total chahiye, date chahiye, order ID chahiye.
It returns typed values, not a paragraph.
Number aayega number ki tarah, date aayegi date ki tarah.
Ye fast kyun hai?
Kyunki ye token by token likhta hi nahi.
Cloudflare says it answers in a single pass, and charges only for input.
Har answer ke saath confidence score bhi aata hai.
Aur agar value input mein hai hi nahi, toh ye null return karta hai... fake guess nahi.
Ab asli numbers dekho.
Yahan se interesting hota hai.
Cloudflare ne ek damage-claim pipeline test ki.
Ek version mein har step ek LLM ne kiya.
Doosre mein Clairic ne values nikali, ek decision model ne decide kiya, aur LLM ne sirf reply likha.
The mixed pipeline took 19.3 seconds. The all-LLM one took 61.7 seconds.
Matlab lagbhag 3.2 times faster, aur unke hisaab se 49 percent sasta.
Pricing bhi docs mein likhi hai... point one zero dollar per million input tokens.
Par honest raho. Ye abhi preview hai.
Cloudflare khud bolta hai ki multi-step arithmetic abhi strong nahi hai.
So let the model read the values, and let your code do the math.
Mera take simple hai... lesson ye hai.
Har kaam ke liye sabse bada LLM mat lagao.
Reading ke liye ek fast model, decision ke liye doosra, aur writing ke liye LLM.
That is how you make AI cheaper, faster and easier to check.
Maan lo aap roz hazaar invoices process karte ho... wahan ye farak bahut bada hai.
